title: SHOULD YOU
EVEN RUN
*GOOGLE ADS?*
slides.sub: Five checks before you spend a dollar.

title: AUD$1,500
*TWO CALLS*
slides.body: "I tried Google Ads once. AUD$1,500 gone, two calls." I hear some version of this every month.

title: PEOPLE SEARCH
*FOR IT*
slides.body: Someone in Carindale types "emergency electrician near me" at 9pm. That's an ad market. Google Ads won't create demand nobody has.

title: ONE JOB
*PAYS FOR*
THE CLICKS
slides.body: Do the maths first. One AUD$400 switchboard job covers a lot of clicks. A AUD$25 haircut has to work much harder.

title: SOMEONE
*ANSWERS*
THE PHONE
slides.body: Ads ring at 9pm on a Tuesday. Voicemail means you paid for a lead your competitor in Aspley just booked.

title: THE PAGE
*GETS THE CALL*
slides.body: One service. One area. One big call button. Sending clicks to your homepage? (Good luck finding the phone number.)

title: CHECK YOUR
*LOCATION*
SETTING
slides.body: Set it to "Presence" so you only pay for people actually in your area. Your Wynnum ad has no business showing in Cairns.

title: *RECAP*
items: People search for what you do
The page has a call button

title: WANT A
*FREE AUDIT?*
slides.body: Send us a DM and I'll check your Google Ads account for free.
